And going. 💪

💥 BANG.

An absolute THUNDERBOLT flies into the net and sends the Gingerbread Men into complete delirium! 🤯

You simply couldn’t write it. 😮‍💨

And that goal? Goal of the Season contender. No question. 🔥🔥🔥

🧤 MAN OF THE MATCH – ROWLEY

Our keeper was outstanding, pulling off some massive saves at crucial moments to keep us in the game. A huge performance when we needed it most.
